browserFailed: the browser could not be opened
busy: an update is already being downloaded or installed
installFailed: the update could not be installed
network: could not reach the update server
notUploaded: some edited files have changes that are not uploaded
restartRequired: restart Carapace to finish or retry the update
signature: the update signature was refused; nothing was installed
unavailable: no usable update information was found
unconfirmed: transfers are running or editors have unsaved changes
